_purpose: Phase 3 cross-language launch matrix — 3 agents × 3 problems × 3 targets × k=5 × 3 tries = 81 cells. Tests H1 (assurance differential at fixed k), H2 (convergence differential inside QF-LIA), H3 (boundary-of-value null-watcher) per experiments/repair-loop/README.md:38-58. Per-problem predicted verification-path engagement pinned at docs/design/phase3-problem-shape-audit.md (Launch-commit-hash field filled at launch). S1–S5/S8 defaults from the language-team Phase-3 scope-decision framing (2026-05-15) encoded inline.

terminal_target._note: Default applied when no per-target override matches. The matrix spans mixed verification surfaces; see `terminal_target_per_target` below.

llmll._s1_note: R6d universal Cred predicate. Encoded per language-team S1 default (Phase-3 scope-decision framing, 2026-05-15). `asserted` is dropped from the accepted-levels set per scripts/run_repair_loop.py:_count_bad_trust_tiers.

toolchain_pins._note: Pin verification enforced by run_matrix.py:check_prereqs at matrix start. Compiler emits `llmll version --json`; Python emits `python3.11 --version`; Go emits `go version`. Mismatch against any of these aborts the matrix per stop-fast discipline A (toolchain pin verification).

_circuit_breaker_note: Stop-fast discipline B (per-cell circuit breaker): if N consecutive cells return terminal_state=infrastructure-fail, abort the matrix and write a partial matrix_report.json with a `circuit_breaker_tripped` field. Default N=3.
_pause_note: Stop-fast discipline D (interim-pause checkpoint): after every K cells, write an interim matrix_report.json and exit with status `paused`. Operator resumes with --resume-from-cell. K=9 corresponds to one full agent×problem×target slice for one try. Set to null/0 to disable.

_audit_pin._note: Per Control #7a at docs/design/language-comparison-experiments.md, the per-problem verification-path-engagement audit is pre-registered at docs/design/phase3-problem-shape-audit.md. The launch-commit-hash field in that audit is filled by language-team in-place edit immediately before this manifest is run. Post-hoc analysis cites the audit at the pinned commit, not at HEAD.
